Start date: 1434-10-23 (Gregorian calendar).  
35 weeks = 245 days.  
Add 6 more days → total 251 days.  

1434-10-23 + 251 days:  
October has 31 days → from Oct 23 to Oct 31 is 8 days.  
251 − 8 = 243 days left.  
November 1434 has 30 days → 243 − 30 = 213.  
December 1434 has 31 days → 213 − 31 = 182.  
1435 is not a leap year (1435 ÷ 4 = 358.75).  
January 1435: 31 → 182 − 31 = 151.  
February 1435: 28 → 151 − 28 = 123.  
March 1435: 31 → 123 − 31 = 92.  
April 1435: 30 → 92 − 30 = 62.  
May 1435: 31 → 62 − 31 = 31.  
June 1435: 30 → 31 − 30 = 1 → goes into July.  
July 1, 1435 is the 1 remaining day.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1435-07-01
